\section{Boundary modes}\label{sec:modes}
\begin{thm}[Edge-state criterion]\label{thm:edge}
If $v_1 > t$ and $v_j=0$ for $j\ge 2$, then $H_L$ admits an exponentially localized eigenstate above the bulk band as $L\to\infty$.
\end{thm}
